$comment: Frozen shared contract for the Ratatosk <-> Igdrasil connect bridge. This file is mirrored byte-for-byte into the Igdrasil repository under services/engine-api/tests/fixtures/igdrasil-connect/. Neither side may hand-roll its own copy of these shapes; both assert against these bytes and against manifest.json.

igdrasil:connect.semantics: upsert: adds a company, or re-establishes one already held. It MUST be an upsert because the token endpoint is one — minting rotates the company's credential server-side, so refusing here would strand the extension holding a token the server no longer accepts. It is also the only way back from a revoked or expired connection. Supplier bindings are keyed by destination id and are untouched.

protocolV1Connect.$comment: A v1-shaped connect carries a session JWT and no state. It must be refused with a typed code, never accepted.

workerUnreachable.$comment: The bridge could not reach the service worker. A transport failure is not a refusal the page earned by sending something wrong.
